title: a compatibility shim: an old name, alias, redirect or fallback kept alive (CLAUDE.md: No compatibility shims)
how: code files the diff touches (tests and vendored code apart): a declared alias / redirect / old-name map, a comment or string that says an old form still works or is fallen back to, a deprecated option, or a page whose label does not name its id (an { id, label } object, or an [id, label] pair in a *TABS / *NAV / *_SUBS / *_VIEWS / *_PAGES list); one finding per line, its message names the fix

explain.what: The code keeps an old form alive: an alias or redirect map, an old name, a fallback to an old format, a deprecated option, or a page whose label does not name its id.
explain.why: A compatibility shim keeps two ways alive after a rename. It is tech debt, and nobody knows when the old one may go (CLAUDE.md, No compatibility shims).
explain.fix: Change every caller, link, test and doc to the new form, and delete the old one. A page's label, id and URL use one name.

fix: change every caller to the new form and delete the old one
